description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2940001259544 FILTER ELEMENT,FLUI: Line 0001 Qty 1106 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0041 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 165. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 11083 1R0716; 11083 2P4005; 75Q65 1HA609; 79396 51792. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
